title: Add tilt control buttons for Venetian blinds (Raffstores) / cover entity
summary: ### What would you like? Add dedicated control buttons to the cover card for managing the tilt position (e.g., tilt open/up and tilt close/down, or step tilting) of cover entities that support slat rotation (Venetian blinds / Raffstores). Homeassistant example cover-card with slat positioning buttons: ### What would it help with? Currently, Home Assistant cover entities for Raffstores support tilt functionality, but within Panalume there is no proper way to manually adjust the slat angle. Even the more-info dialog doesn't offer a dedicated tilt control—forcing users into awkward workarounds like briefly tapping open/close and immediately hitting stop just to adjust the slats. Adding direct tilt control buttons to the cover card would solve this completely, making it fast and intuitive to manage sunlight and privacy without tedious workarounds. ### Integrations or devices involved (if any) _No response_
